status: NO IMAGE RETAINED. Rights for LilyGO's product photography were not established, and no third-party teardown with clear licensing was located. This manifest records what exists, where, and what would have to be resolved before retaining any of it.

gaps: No image of the board's back at a magnification that would resolve the U6 charger marking. That single photograph would settle conflict G2, which is the largest open question about this board.
No independent teardown with clear licensing was located.
No photograph of the two 0-ohm antenna-select resistor positions other than LilyGO's own annotated illustration.
No photograph distinguishing a CST816S board from a CST328 board externally (there may be no external difference).
